## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-mcp-scoreboard`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-mcp-scoreboard -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `items.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `LICENSE`
- `README.md`
- `items.jsonl`
- `mcpbench.json`
- `LEADERBOARD.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/mcp-scoreboard at revision `02ee0d4e187d7be339d795c39a4348bc66377ce4`, made 2026-09-29. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# MCP tool-conformance bank

A frozen conformance bank for MCP tools. Each row of `items.jsonl` describes a tool's
declared behaviour against its actual behaviour and gives the `expected` verdict with a rule `anchor` —
`DECLARED_READONLY` (annotated read-only, mutates state), `BOUNDED_EGRESS` (traffic outside the declared
scope), silent clamping of a declared schema bound, and so on. The rows carry `"axis": "conformance"`.

Superseded as the live bank — the conformance slot is published as
[`csoai/gspc-mcp`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-mcp). Kept so inbound links resolve.

## Dataset facts (checked 2026-11-20)

- Kaggle version 1, last updated 2026-09-29.
- 6 files, 25,261 bytes. File types: .md (2), .jsonl (2), (none) (1), .json (1).
- Hugging Face twin: [csoai/mcp-scoreboard](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/mcp-scoreboard). 5 of 6 files have the same byte size there.
- Expected update frequency: never.
